summary: composer.clarificationChips shows the options of an open clarification as chips above the composer; the card in the message then keeps question and free text only (ClarificationCardProps.showOptions). ClarificationChips renders them in own panels.
howTo: Set composer: { clarificationChips: true } on AiChatProvider. A chip sends the same answer as the card's option button; chips hide while a turn runs, once answered and for free-text-only clarifications, and are disabled while the composer is locked. A custom components.ClarificationCard receives showOptions (false while chips are on) and should leave its option buttons out then. Own panels render <ClarificationChips /> above the composer; group name locale.clarificationChipsLabel. See references/composer-starters-drafts.md#clarification-chips.
